preconditions.description: The list contains at least one number.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in numbers)
preconditions.description: Every element in the list is an integer.

postconditions.description: The returned value is an element from the input list.

postconditions.expression: len(str(abs(return_value))) == max(len(str(abs(x))) for x in numbers)
postconditions.description: The returned number has the maximum number of digits among all numbers in the list.

postconditions.expression: all(len(str(abs(x))) < len(str(abs(return_value))) or numbers.index(x) > numbers.index(return_value) for x in numbers if x != return_value or numbers.count(x) > 1)
postconditions.description: If multiple numbers have the same maximum number of digits, the one appearing earliest in the list is returned.
